error_troubleshooting_modal.title: Troubleshooting Help

passkey_overview.title: About Passkeys
passkey_overview.description: Passkeys are a more secure and convenient way to sign in. They use your device's biometric authentication (fingerprint, face recognition) or PIN.
passkey_overview.benefit2: No passwords to remember or lose
passkey_overview.benefit3: Encrypted and stored only on your device

passkey_faq.question1: What if I accidentally cancelled the request?
passkey_faq.answer1: Simply click the 'Retry' button to restart the authentication process.
passkey_faq.question2: Why is my device not showing the biometric prompt?
passkey_faq.answer2: Ensure your device screen is unlocked and you haven't disabled biometric authentication in your system settings.
passkey_faq.question3: What if I haven't set up biometrics yet?
passkey_faq.answer3: You can usually use your device's screen lock PIN or pattern as a fallback, or set up a fingerprint/face recognition in your device settings.
passkey_faq.question4: Are there specific browser permissions needed?
passkey_faq.answer4: Some browsers may require permission to access security keys. Check your browser settings if you're experiencing issues.
passkey_faq.answer5: Most modern devices and browsers support passkeys. If you're on an older system, you may need to update your software.
passkey_faq.question6: The request timed out. What should I do?
passkey_faq.answer6: Authentication requests have a time limit. If it expires, please try again.

error_troubleshooting_modal.biometric_help_description: If you're having trouble with fingerprint or face recognition:
error_troubleshooting_modal.biometric_help_point1: Ensure your sensor is clean and dry.
error_troubleshooting_modal.biometric_help_point2: Try using your device PIN if biometrics fail multiple times.
error_troubleshooting_modal.biometric_help_point3: Restart your device if the biometric system seems unresponsive.
error_troubleshooting_modal.still_need_help_description: If none of the above solutions work, please contact our support team for further assistance.

wallet_help_modal.title: Your Bitcoin Wallet
wallet_help_modal.hero_description: Send, receive, and manage Bitcoin across multiple networks with full control of your funds.
wallet_help_modal.multi_network_description: Pay and receive with Bitcoin, Lightning, Liquid, Rootstock, and USDT - all in one wallet.
wallet_help_modal.security_description: You control your keys. BitTasker never holds your funds - only you can move your Bitcoin.
wallet_help_modal.lightning_description: Instant Bitcoin payments with the Lightning Network. No waits, no delays, just peer-to-peer speed.
wallet_help_modal.escrow_description: Automatic fund protection with time locks. Get paid when the work is done, get refunded if it's not.
wallet_help_modal.step1_description: Pay however you want using atomic swaps and your preferred network.
wallet_help_modal.step2_description: Your funds are protected by advanced cryptography. Only you and the other party can release payments.
wallet_help_modal.step3_description: Convert your earnings to any supported format - Lightning, Bitcoin, Liquid, or USDT - whenever you want.
wallet_help_modal.benefits_description: Traditional platforms hold your money and charge fees. BitTasker gives you control with Bitcoin security and Lightning speed.
wallet_help_modal.faq_rsk_description: Rootstock Bitcoin (rBTC) is a Bitcoin sidechain that maintains 1:1 parity with Bitcoin while enabling smart contracts and faster transactions. It is secured by Bitcoin miners through merged mining, making it one of the most secure Bitcoin sidechains available.
wallet_help_modal.faq_rsk_security_desc: Secured by Bitcoin miners through merged mining
wallet_help_modal.faq_rsk_contracts_desc: Full EVM compatibility for programmable payment contracts
wallet_help_modal.faq_rsk_settlement_desc: ~30 second block times for quick confirmations
wallet_help_modal.faq_rsk_peg_desc: 1:1 rBTC to BTC ratio maintained through Proof of Work Peg
wallet_help_modal.faq_liquid_description: Liquid Bitcoin (L-BTC) is a Bitcoin sidechain designed for fast settlements and enhanced functionality. It provides faster transaction confirmations and additional features while maintaining Bitcoin's security model through federation.
wallet_help_modal.faq_liquid_settlement_desc: 1 minute block times for quick transaction confirmations
wallet_help_modal.faq_liquid_scripting_desc: Advanced Bitcoin script capabilities for complex payment contracts
wallet_help_modal.faq_liquid_assets_desc: Native support for multiple digital assets
wallet_help_modal.faq_liquid_peg_desc: 1:1 L-BTC to BTC ratio through federated peg
wallet_help_modal.faq_liquid_fees_desc: Predictable transaction costs for all work sizes
wallet_help_modal.faq_lightning_description: Yes! You can deposit and withdraw using Lightning Bitcoin for instant, low-cost payments. However, for escrow contracts, we automatically convert Lightning payments to Rootstock to ensure secure, non-custodial fund protection.
wallet_help_modal.faq_lightning_deposits_desc: Send Lightning payments that are instantly available
wallet_help_modal.faq_lightning_fees_desc: Pay minimal fees for Lightning transactions
wallet_help_modal.faq_lightning_conversion_desc: Lightning funds are swapped to rBTC for escrow contracts
wallet_help_modal.faq_lightning_withdrawals_desc: Convert escrow contract funds back to Lightning anytime
wallet_help_modal.faq_lightning_adoption_desc: Lightning is one of the most widely adopted Bitcoin sidechains
wallet_help_modal.faq_escrow_title: Why doesn't BitTasker just use Lightning for escrow?
wallet_help_modal.faq_escrow_description: While Lightning excels at instant payments, creating easy-to-use non-custodial escrow contracts on Lightning remains technically complex. We use Rootstock for escrow because it provides the security, privacy, and reliability needed to protect your funds.
wallet_help_modal.faq_escrow_channels_desc: Limited number of open channels per node for escrow contracts
wallet_help_modal.faq_escrow_time_desc: Escrow contracts limited to hours, not days or weeks
wallet_help_modal.faq_escrow_contracts_desc: Lightning lacks programmable escrow contract functionality
wallet_help_modal.faq_escrow_multisig_desc: The Lightning network lacks the programmable contract features needed for escrow
wallet_help_modal.faq_escrow_risks_desc: Risk of fund loss if Lightning nodes close or disconnect

secure_payment_contract_modal.title: Secure Payment Contract
secure_payment_contract_modal.hero_title: How Your Secure Payment Contract Works
secure_payment_contract_modal.hero_description: Your funds are locked in a blockchain smart contract. Only the contract rules can release them—nobody else can access your money.
secure_payment_contract_modal.for_taskers_locked: **Funds locked:** Funds remain locked until you accept completed work.
secure_payment_contract_modal.for_taskers_review: **7-day review period:** You have 7 days to review after completion. If you don't respond, payment is automatically released.
secure_payment_contract_modal.for_taskers_grace: **1-hour grace period:** Cancel within 1 hour of booking and get a full automatic refund.
secure_payment_contract_modal.for_taskers_dispute: **Dispute rights:** Raise disputes within 7 days of completion. If unresolved after 14 days, you get a full refund.
secure_payment_contract_modal.for_taskers_cancel: **Cancel anytime:** Cancel for a full refund at any point, except within 24 hours of start time.
secure_payment_contract_modal.for_taskers_no_show: **No-show protection:** If the Taskee doesn't start on time, mark them as no-show. They have 24 hours to respond or you get a full refund.
secure_payment_contract_modal.for_taskees_guaranteed: **Guaranteed payment:** Once you mark work as complete, the Tasker has 7 days to accept. If they don't respond, you're paid automatically after 7 days.
secure_payment_contract_modal.for_taskees_upfront: **Upfront deposits:** You can request partial payment upfront (claimable after the 1-hour grace period).
secure_payment_contract_modal.for_taskees_dispute: **Dispute rights:** You can propose how to split payment during disputes (up to 2 proposals).
secure_payment_contract_modal.for_taskees_refund: **Voluntary refund:** You can refund the Tasker at any time.
secure_payment_contract_modal.platform_fees_both: **Fees:** Both parties pay fees to BitTasker when money moves. Fees are deducted automatically, not upfront.
secure_payment_contract_modal.time_limits_24h: **24 hours:** Cancel for a full refund (except within 24 hours of start time)
secure_payment_contract_modal.time_limits_1h: **1 hour:** Grace period for full refunds
secure_payment_contract_modal.time_limits_7d: **7 days:** Tasker review period after completion
secure_payment_contract_modal.time_limits_14d: **14 days:** Escalation period before automatic release
secure_payment_contract_modal.dispute_propose: **Propose a split:** Either party can propose how to divide the payment
secure_payment_contract_modal.dispute_agree: **Agreement:** If both parties agree to a split, the funds are released accordingly
secure_payment_contract_modal.dispute_escalate: **Escalate:** If no agreement, BitTasker reviews and decides within 14 days
secure_payment_contract_modal.dispute_final: **Final decision:** BitTasker's decision is final and funds are released
secure_payment_contract_modal.time_limits_grace: **1-hour grace period:** Full refund available within the first hour
secure_payment_contract_modal.time_limits_cancellation: **Cancellation window:** Cancel before work begins for a full refund
secure_payment_contract_modal.time_limits_review: **Review period:** 7 days to review completed work
secure_payment_contract_modal.time_limits_dispute: **Dispute window:** 14 days to resolve disputes before escalation
secure_payment_contract_modal.time_limits_no_show: **No-show protection:** 24 hours for taskee to respond to no-show claims
secure_payment_contract_modal.dispute_process_step1: **Step 1:** Either party can raise a dispute if there's an issue with the work
secure_payment_contract_modal.dispute_process_step2: **Step 2:** Both parties can propose how to split the payment (up to 2 proposals each)
secure_payment_contract_modal.dispute_process_step3: **Step 3:** If both agree to a split, funds are released accordingly
secure_payment_contract_modal.dispute_process_step4: **Step 4:** If no agreement after 14 days, the tasker receives a full refund
secure_payment_contract_modal.cancellation_tasker: **Taskers:** Can cancel anytime for a full refund, except within 24 hours of scheduled start
secure_payment_contract_modal.cancellation_taskee: **Taskees:** Can voluntarily refund the tasker at any time
